d:
Spain and Australia delivered one of the MOST DRAMATIC games in FIBA Basketball World Cup history!
In the 2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup semifinals, these two basketball powerhouses went head-to-head in an unbelievable battle that couldn't be decided in regulation or even after the FIRST overtime!
It took TWO OVERTIMES to separate them, with Spain finally pulling away to secure a thrilling 95-88 victory and book their place in the FINAL!
